resetData.title: Reset Spotlight Data
resetData.description: Clears all spotlight data stored so far. This is a non-reversible action.

sortMode.title: Spotlight Sorting Mode
sortMode.description: How to sort players as spotlight are given and removed.

sessionAutoStart.title: Session Auto Start
sessionAutoStart.description: If enabled, the module will automatically start a new spotlight session when the window is open and the current date differs from the date of the last registered session.

playerFilter.title: Player filter
playerFilter.description: Whether to show only active/connected players on the tracker.

nameMode.title: Name Display
nameMode.description: How should each player be represented in the tracker?
